display_long_description:
Turn your real-world space into your own snooker room with MiRacle Snooker!

Built for Mixed Reality, MiRacle Snooker places a virtual snooker table directly into your real environment, combining the presence of physical play with the convenience of VR. Have enough space? Go for the full-size experience. Playing in a smaller room? Choose a smaller table and enjoy snooker without needing a dedicated snooker hall.

Whether you want to practice, compete, or simply play with friends, MiRacle Snooker gives you multiple ways to enjoy the game.

# PRACTICE
Play alone with complete freedom. Take your time, experiment with shots, work on your technique, or simply enjoy the table at your own pace.

# PLAY AGAINST AI
Challenge 9 AI opponents with different skill levels. Start with an easier opponent or test yourself against increasingly capable players.

# ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Compete against players from around the world. 

# PRIVATE ROOMS
Want to play with someone you know? Create a private room and enjoy a match with your friends.

With realistic snooker gameplay, flexible table sizes, online multiplayer, AI opponents, and the unique presence of Mixed Reality, MiRacle Snooker brings the snooker experience home — without needing the space for a real table.

Place your table. Pick up your cue. Start your break.

Welcome to MiRacle Snooker.
